v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Missus est * Gábriel Angelus ad Maríam Vírginem desponsátam Ioseph.
text.en: The Angel Gabriel was sent * to a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph; and the virgin's name was Mary.

text.la: Ave, María, * grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus.
text.en: Hail, Mary, * full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women.

text.la: Ne tímeas, María, * invenísti grátiam apud Dóminum: ecce concípies et páries fílium.
text.en: Fear not, Mary, * thou hast found grace with the Lord; behold, thou shalt conceive, and bring forth a Son.

text.la: Dabit ei Dóminus * sedem David, patris eius, et regnábit in ætérnum.
text.en: The Lord shall give unto Him * the throne of His father David, and of His kingdom there shall be no end.

text.la: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum.
text.en: Behold the handmaid of the Lord, * be it unto me according to thy word.

text.la: Ecce virgo concípiet, et páriet fílium, et vocábitur nomen eius Emmánuel. Butýrum et mel cómedet, ut sciat reprobáre malum, et elígere bonum.
text.en: Behold a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and his name shall be called Emmanuel. He shall eat butter and honey, that he may know to refuse the evil, and to choose the good.

text.la: Quómodo fiet istud, * Angele Dei, quóniam virum non cognósco? Audi, María Virgo: Spíritus Sanctus supervéniet in te, et virtus Altíssimi obumbrábit tibi.
text.en: How shall this be, * thou Angel of God, seeing I know not a man? Hear, O Virgin Mary: the Holy Ghost shall come upon thee, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee.

text.la: Deus, qui de beátæ Maríæ Vírginis útero Verbum tuum, Angelo nuntiánte, carnem suscípere voluísti: præsta supplícibus tuis; ut, qui vere eam Genetrícem Dei crédimus, eius apud te intercessiónibus adiuvémur.
text.en: O God, Who didst will that thy Word should, by the message of an Angel, take flesh in the womb of the Blessed Virgin Mary, grant unto us, we beseech thee, that all who do believe her to be in very deed the Mother of God, may be helped by her prayers in thy sight.

title.la: Sabbato infra Hebdomadam III in Quadragesima
title.en: Sabbato infra Hebdomadam III in Quadragesima

text.la: Inclinávit se Iesus, et scribébat in terra: Si quis sine peccáto est, mittat in eam lápidem.
text.en: Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground: He that is without sin, let him cast a stone at her.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui se, affligéndo carnem, ab aliméntis ábstinent; sectándo iustítiam a culpa ieiúnent.
text.en: O Almighty God, grant, we beseech thee, that as many as, to afflict the body, do abstain from meats, may, by following after righteousness, fast from sin.
